item.name: Akamai Validate an EdgeWorkers Code Bundle

request.name: Akamai Validate an EdgeWorkers Code Bundle

description.content: Return a list of errors and warnings containing details on how to fix your code bundle. See [Validation types](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edgeworkers/reference/validation-types). In order to run this operation you need to provide an EdgeWorkers code bundle as a GZIP binary file in the request body, with a `Content-Type` of `application/gzip`.

query.description: For customers who manage more than one account, this [runs the operation from another account](https://techdocs.akamai.com/developer/docs/manage-many-accounts-with-one-api-client). The Identity and Access Management API provides a [list of available account switch keys](https://techdocs.akamai.com/iam-api/reference/get-client-account-switch-keys).

response.name: Provides details for an EdgeWorkers code bundle validation.
